title: Jaspreet Singh: Grown Up
overview: In his debut special, Grown Up, Jaspreet Singh dives into the chaos of becoming a father, the bittersweet realization of his own upbringing, and the sudden loss that changed everything. Blending absurd delivery room stories with nostalgic memories of his brothers, he pieces together a journey of growth, grief, and humor. Dedicated to his father, this special is a full-circle story of what it truly means to grow up.
